**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Text is not supported directly in table structure
```

## How to fix

Move the text into a cell: `<tr><td>text</td></tr>` (text directly in `<table>/<tbody>/<thead>/<tfoot>/<tr>` is foster-parented by the parser).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <table>hello</table>;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <table><tbody><tr><td>hello</td></tr></tbody></table>;
```

## When it is reported

DOM target only (targets: ["dom"]).
